explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1203: F(n) = sup_k ω(n+k)·log log k/log k tends to ∞. The real iSup is not junk: for fixed n, ω(n+k) ≤ (1+o(1)) log(n+k)/log log(n+k), so the terms are bounded as k → ∞. Small-k junk values (log 0 = 0, negative log log 2) cannot inflate the supremum. It is correctly marked open.
